parts.note_add: S-001 Section F: F-05 (LH) / F-06 (RH) front turn and parking light, 3-pin connector RG (parking 8 W), GR/GO (turn 27 W), B (LH to ground X-13, RH to X-14). Lamp set FA01-89-667 (L) is NLA at Mazdatrix; the Thingiverse 1157 housing (125x36x29 mm, author unsure which lamp) may be this lamp's body - confirm against the part.
Trade 1157: S-8 glass, BAY15d double-contact indexed bayonet, 12.8 V 2.10 A (27 W) / 14 V 0.59 A (8 W); front position uses the 27 W filament for turn (GR/GO) and 8 W for parking (RG).
Amber lens; FA01-51-071 (L) was in stock new at Mazdatrix (USD 41.06) in 2026-09; FA01-51-061 (R) seen new and used on eBay.

Catalogue calls it 'side turn lamp' but on the 1982 US car S-001 wires it as the front side marker, F-12 (LH) / F-13 (RH): RG from the light switch and B, lit with the parking lamps, not flashing. FA01-89-668 (L) NLA at Mazdatrix.
Trade 194: T-3 1/4 glass wedge, 14 V 0.27 A (3.8 W), 2 MSCP.
FA01-51-131 (L) listed NLA (discontinued by Mazda) at Mazdatrix; used only.

S-001 Section F: F-07 (LH) / F-08 (RH), 6-cavity connector GR/GO turn, RW back-up, one cavity unused, G stop (from stop light checker F-03), RG tail, B ground to X-15; each side holds two 1157 (stop/tail) and two 1156 (turn, back-up). Lamp sets FA01-89-664/669 NLA at Mazdatrix; a 3D scan of the RH housing exists.
Trade 1156: S-8 glass, BA15s single-contact bayonet, 12.8 V 2.10 A (27 W), 32 MSCP; one per side for turn (GR/GO) and one for back-up (RW).
Two per side (S-001 '27/8W x2'): 27 W filaments on G (stop, via stop light checker), 8 W filaments on RG (tail).
FA01-51-151D (R) and FA01-51-161D (L) listed NLA (discontinued by Mazda) at Mazdatrix; used only.
S-001 Section F: F-04 license light LH and RH, two single-wire connectors RG (from the light switch tail bus) and B (ground X-15), 6 W each.
Mazda 9970-03-060T is 12 V 6 W; a bulb-chart site (S-019) gives trade 89 (13 V 0.58 A, BA15s, G-6), which does not match 6 W exactly - confirm the base and trade number on the removed bulb.
3874-66-371 fits all 81-85 RX-7, two per car; listed No Longer Available at Atkins Rotary (was USD 8.25).
